facts.raw_span: A 63-year-old Chinese farmer
1-month history of papules and pustules on his nose
prior trauma to his nasal skin during farm work
denied fever, cough, joint pain, or other systemic symptoms
no hypertension, diabetes, or immunosuppression
multiple papules and pustules on an erythematous base over the nasal dorsum
some with superficial ulceration and yellow crusting
no palpable cervical, axillary, or facial lymphadenopathy
treated with systemic and topical antibiotics at a local hospital without improvement
